answer: Re-execute 1 in 20 submissions on unrelated peers, pay the submitter a third when the three re-runs disagree, and vest every reward against 100 epochs of future work. Numbers, 5 percent sample, 3 re-runs, 33 percent payout on disagreement, 100-epoch vest. A farm running 500 seats sees 25 re-runs per epoch and cannot predict which. A tundra of parked seats earns 0 while the vest clock runs, an anchor of 20 clean re-runs is the only asset that transfers, and yarrow grows back faster than a slashed record.
